label: no live-holder refusal
old:
if [ -n "$held" ] && kill -0 "$held" 2>/dev/null; then
      say "release: another release is running (pid $held); nothing shipped"
      log "SKIP another release is running (pid $held)"
      exit 0
    fi

label: no stale-lock clear
old:
say "release: clearing a stale release lock (pid ${held:-unknown})"
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
new: say "release: clearing a stale release lock (pid ${held:-unknown})"

label: hub stage trap drops the lock cleanup
